title: Horror Escape
specs: Rooms contain loud noises, sudden openings, and immersive elements
Guests under 15 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian 18+ for The House of Occult and The Wishmaster rooms
Guests under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian 18+ for Motel 66 room
All electronics including smartphones, cameras, flashlights, calculators, lighters, and e-cigarettes are prohibited inside rooms
Rooms contain flashing lights; some have artificial smoke machines
Wheelchair ramp available; The Wishmaster and The House of Occult are most wheelchair-friendly with some narrow passages
Group discounts for 15 or more participants
Room maximums enforced for safety and quality; larger groups can be split into multiple rooms
includes: Lockers for electronics and prohibited items
gap: Exact maximum and minimum group sizes per room not stated
blurb: Guests participate in private escape room experiences lasting 45 minutes each. Rooms are dark and contain puzzles, loud noises, flashing lights, and some have artificial smoke. Electronics and food or beverages are prohibited inside the rooms to prevent cheating and protect the rooms' quality.
extraNote: 12 hours prior notice required to adjust or reschedule booking · 24 hours prior notice required for cancellation · Flexible cancellation policy for illness or emergency upon contact · Full payment required to reserve a time slot · Walk-ins accepted but no guarantee of availability · Downtown Victoria location with a parking lot
